SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. B. REGISTRY.
No. D 3550.
Date 22 / 4 / 38.

April 22, 2.

Sir,

I have to acknowledge, with thanks, receipt of
your letter No.25 of April 21 regarding a communist
demonstration scheduled for today and to inform you
that the matter is receiving attention.

I am, Sir,

Your obedient servant,

Officer i/c Special Branch.

Colonel Wen Ying Sing,
Chief of the Public Safety Bureau,
Greater Shanghai Municipality.

逕复者准

page_data.en:
Form 226
S. 500-5-31

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
COMMISSIONER'S OFFICE.

Translation of Letter from Shanghai Public Safety Bureau.
政 April 21, 1932.

Major General,
Commissioner of Police,
S. M. P.

Sir,

According to a confidential report received
stating that a resolution was passed in a meeting
held by the Communist Central Committee to the
effect that circulars should be issued by the
Communist Jiangsu Provincial Committee to its
branches ordering them to gather unemployed labourers
and ricksha coolies to start a demonstration and to
propagate Communism by distributing leaf-bills in
some business centres and crowded places at 10 a.m.
on April 22, the third-day of the late Lenin, the
Communist leader of Soviet Russia.

Apart from precautionary measures being taken
by us, it is hoped that precautions be taken in your
districts as well.

Yen Tien Sheng,
Chief of Public Safety Bureau,
Shanghai.

S2, For attention please.
M.S
22/4/32.
Reg. Please reply say thanks
Done @ 27/4.
M.S

表格 226
S. 500-5-31

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
总监办公室。

上海市公安局来函译文。
1932年4月21日。

致：
警务处总监，
少将阁下，
上海公共租界工部局警务处。

先生：

据收到的一份机密报告称，共产党中央委员会在一次会议上通过了一项决议，内容为：由共产党江苏省委向其各支部发出通告，命令其召集失业劳工及人力车夫，于4月22日上午10时——即苏俄共产党领袖列宁逝世三周年纪念日——在一些商业中心和人群拥挤之处举行示威游行，并通过散发传单宣传共产主义。

除我局已采取预防措施外，亦望贵局在各管区内采取相应防范措施。

上海市公安局局长
颜惠生（音译）
上海

S2，请予关注。
M.S
1932年4月22日。
登记。请回复致谢
已于4月27日办理。
M.S
